## Peer review and editorial service

<p class="leadership-intro">
I contribute to the scholarly community by reviewing research across artificial
intelligence, media, communication, and digital society.
</p>

::: {.service-columns}

::: {.service-panel}
<div class="service-icon bi bi-journal-check" aria-hidden="true"></div>

### Journal and editorial service

- **Invited Reviewer**, *Media and Communication*, Cogitatio Press (2026)
- **Invited Reviewer**, *New Media & Society*, SAGE Publications (2025)
- **Editorial Board Member**, *Carl Advance Multidisciplinary Journal of Social Sciences* (2025)
- **Reviewer**, *Cognexus*, Wenjibra University Press (2025)

These roles include reviewing manuscripts on AI, media, technology, and digital
communication and contributing constructive scholarly feedback.
:::

::: {.service-panel}
<div class="service-icon bi bi-people-fill" aria-hidden="true"></div>

### Conference review and service

- **Conference Reviewer**, International Communication Association (2025)
- **Conference Reviewer**, Association of Internet Researchers (2023–2025)
- **Conference Reviewer**, National Communication Association (2023–2024)
- **Reviewer**, Klein College Graduate Research Forum (2025)
- **Convention Volunteer**, NCA 110th Annual Convention (2024)

My conference service includes evaluating submissions, providing scholarly
feedback, and supporting conference logistics and attendees.
:::
